terminals.name: jupyter-lab
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run jupyter lab --no-browser --port 8888 --ip 0.0.0.0 --ServerApp.token="" --ServerApp.password=""
terminals.description: Jupyter Lab server for running the cookbook notebooks. Open http://localhost:8888/lab. Live cells call the Claude API and need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (and VOYAGE_API_KEY for some embedding notebooks) set as environment secrets.
